summary: MCR Machinery is a Dutch maker of washing, cutting, handling and sorting machines and complete processing lines for potatoes, vegetables and fruit, based in Marknesse. It was founded in 2007 by Jan Pieter Reijnoudt as a repair and construction business. Its seed potato cutter is rated at up to 7 tonnes per hour.
machines: Drum washer: washes potatoes from the field and separates dirt, drums 1200 to 2000 mm
Brush washer and polisher: rinses, cleans and polishes potatoes with rotating brushes
Brushwasher BW800 and BW1600: washes, polishes and peels, at least 500 kg of potatoes per hour
Seed potato cutter: cuts seed potatoes transversely in four lanes, up to 7 t/h
Potato cutting line: semi-automatic, portions potatoes with adjustable cutting length
Grading drum (tuber sorting drum): removes residual pieces from the product stream after cutting
Roller inspection table: inspection in drum washing and sliver-removal lines
Box tipper and infeed bunker: unloads boxes and feeds product into lines
Shaker conveyor: vibratory infeed to the seed potato cutter
Water recycling unit: filters and reuses washing water
facts: Founded in 2007 by Jan Pieter Reijnoudt; name stands for Machine Constructie Reijnoudt
The About Us page lists 11 team members
Drum washer capacity given as 5 to 120 tons (time unit not stated)

contact.address: MCR Machinery B.V., Oudeweg 12, 8316 AC Marknesse, Netherlands
